title: Không cay nhé
summary: Say "Not spicy please" with Không cay nhé, then use the notes below to adjust tone and next steps.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Không cay nhé answers the traveler question "Not spicy please" in ordering, adjusting dishes, and checking ingredients. This comes before the dish is prepared if you want mild food. This is one of the most practical restaurant safety phrases. Its job is stating the limit before the order or interaction moves too far.
